days.drive: TIV → Vrmac tunnel / Kotor → M-1 to Risan / Lipci → M-8 via Grahovo → M-7 to Nikšić (20-min fuel and restroom break) → M-3 to Jasenovo Polje → M-6 via Šavnik → Runolist Chalet · nominal 3 h 38 min / 4 h 22 min adjusted (+20%) plus the break; live route controls

morning.text: Confirmed EL AL flight LY5467: depart TLV at 11:50 and arrive TIV at 13:50 on Oct 1 (PNR 5682367).
morning.title: Land at Tivat (LY5467)

morning.text: Landing at 13:50 leaves only 40 minutes before the 14:30 pickup. Go directly to the Arrivals desk and call Europcar at +382 20 653141 if delayed.

Europcar voucher 4H419663: pickup at Tivat Airport at 14:30; Europcar desk is in Arrivals and the car is at the airport. Rental booking total €362 (paid); class IGAR automatic crossover, Skoda Karoq or similar.
morning.title: Europcar pickup at Tivat Arrivals

morning.text: Voucher refs: Flexible Autos 4H419663 / Europcar 1207623276. The €1,154 IGAR deposit requires a physical Visa, Mastercard or AmEx credit card in the main driver’s name; debit, virtual, prepaid and cash are not accepted. Bring original passport, licence, international driving permit and voucher.

IGAR supplier excess is €1,089 (tax treatment per rental terms). Flexible Autos Excess Refund reimburses eligible claims; it is not an Europcar excess waiver and does not remove the deposit. The separate policy lists tires/wheels and undercarriage for reimbursement subject to terms, but excludes off-road/untarmacked and negligent driving; do not buy duplicate counter cover without checking terms.
After the 14:30 voucher pickup, aim to leave around 15:15–15:30 only if landing, rental collection, driver and live road/weather checks are all on track.

Snow is possible in the north in early October: Žabljak had snow in late September 2026 and on Oct 8–12, 2025. Pack warm layers and gloves. Before leaving Tivat, download the Google Maps offline map of Montenegro, because P14 and long northern stretches have no signal. At pickup, check the spare tyre and jack.
For any damage to the car, even a scratch, call the police (122) and get a written report before leaving; rental insurance claims need it.

afternoon.text: Drive north via the Vrmac tunnel and Kotor, then M-1 to Risan/Lipci, M-8 via Grahovo and M-7 to Nikšić.
afternoon.title: Drive Tivat to Nikšić via Grahovo
Break at EKO fuel station, Nikšić
afternoon.text: Planned 20-minute break about two hours in, before sunset: fill the tank, use the restroom and pick up coffee or a snack in the station shop. It is the last easy services stop before the dark mountain section via Šavnik. Station hours are not published; if it is closed, use the Petrol station on Bulevar 13. jula, which OpenStreetMap lists as open around the clock.

afternoon.title: Drive Nikšić to Runolist via Šavnik
afternoon.text: Continue on M-3 to Jasenovo Polje and M-6 via Šavnik to Runolist Chalet. This section runs after sunset on a narrow mountain road; keep the speed down.
Check live navigation for closures or reroutes.

Use 3 h 38 min as a nominal routed estimate; current sources vary (published figures start near 3 h 20 min) and live traffic/weather can extend it, then add 20%: about 4 h 22 min adjusted, plus the 20-minute Nikšić break, before traffic.
That points to roughly 20:00 arrival, including the 20-minute Nikšić break.
Žabljak sunset on Oct 1 is about 18:26 and civil twilight ends about 18:55, so this deliberately breaks the usual daylight cutoff.
The Nikšić break is the only planned stop; do not add the Lepetane ferry, viewpoints or a swim.

If the flight or rental is delayed, visibility/weather is poor, roads are restricted, or the driver is tired, stay at your stop safely and arrange lodging directly; resume only after a fresh road/weather and driver check and coordination with Runolist.

If conditions deteriorate after you leave, do not press on: stop at the next safe town, arrange lodging and secure the bags. After dark, watch for rockfall on the road and drive slowly. For a puncture, call AMSCG roadside assistance (19807) and Europcar (+382 20 653141).

evening.text: Check in and unload every bag.
evening.title: Check in and unload at Runolist

evening.text: Dinner at Zlatni Papagaj after check-in (published 18:00–23:00); call ahead with your ~20:00 arrival time, and use food arranged ahead if you arrive too late or too tired.
evening.title: Dinner at Zlatni Papagaj

evening.text: Runolist confirmation 5203973379: Two-Bedroom House for 2 adults; check-in Oct 1, 14:00–24:00. Total €225.39, cash-only at the property; paid amount/balance is not stated. Free cancellation through Sep 29, 2026 23:59 CEST, then €219.39; no-show fee same. Tell the host your arrival time in advance; +382 69 520 016.

days.parking: Runolist Chalet, Narodnih heroja, 84220 Žabljak. Booking.com listing indicates free private parking and shared kitchen access; confirm the booked unit’s access with the host. Booking 5203973379; cash-only payment at property, payment status/balance due not stated.
days.cash: Keep up to €225.39 in cash available for Runolist until the already-paid amount is confirmed. Car rental €362 is paid; Europcar requires a physical Visa, Mastercard or AmEx credit card in the main driver’s name for a €1,154 deposit (fuel/extras may require more).
stops: TIV → Runolist Chalet direct route via Kotor, Risan, Grahovo, Nikšić and Šavnik
days.heading: Tivat → Nikšić break → Runolist Chalet / northbound mountain transfer

meals.hours: Official airport listing: aligned to airport opening hours; verify service and stock on arrival
meals.parking: Inside terminal; collect food before rental pickup
meals.plan: Eat before the 15:15–15:30 go/no-go departure window. If airport time is tight, carry sealed food from the flight; do not stop on the mountain road.

meals.name: Zlatni Papagaj · Žabljak
meals.specialty: Traditional local cuisine, stews and meats; a walk/taxi dinner after check-in, with packed food if kitchen access is unavailable.
meals.parking: Do not drive after the transfer; walk/taxi from lodging. Venue parking not confirmed.
meals.cash: Cash-only unverified; carry cash and ask
meals.plan: Call ahead, arrange late table/takeaway, or eat pre-packed lodging food if flight/road delays push arrival past service.

supermarkets.hours: Hours not confirmed; call/check same day
supermarkets.parking: Dedicated lot indicated in branch materials; large-car fit not directly confirmed
supermarkets.plan: Optional pantry stop before ascending only if flight, pickup, daylight/safety checks leave ample margin; default is shop before travel or Day 2 in Žabljak.

supermarkets.parking: Street/lot parking not verified for loaded-car stop
supermarkets.plan: Base-hub pantry top-up on Day 2 after unloading. Do not add to late Day 1 transfer.

days.drive: Runolist → Black Lake → P14/R-16 over Sedlo → Trsa → Plužine/Piva → (live choice: M-3 via Nikšić and Šavnik, or return over Sedlo) → Runolist · ~3 h 53 adjusted on the Sedlo return (the M-3 return via Nikšić and Šavnik routes at about 6 h 19 adjusted and exceeds the 6 h ceiling); 6 h ceiling and daylight gates

morning.text: Breakfast at Runolist without rushing; leave around 08:00 with water and a packed lunch. Fill the tank and download the P14 map before leaving town.
morning.title: Depart Runolist

morning.text: Park at the signed Black Lake lot by about 08:20. The full shore loop is about 3.6 km; allow up to 90 minutes for the walk and photos, then leave by about 10:00.
morning.title: Drive to Black Lake parking

morning.text: Walk the Black Lake shore loop at an easy pace. The small-lake shore can be damp and slippery; use grippy shoes and turn back if footing or visibility worsens.
morning.title: Black Lake shore loop

morning.text: Coffee was taken at Black Lake, so skip the town espresso stop and drive straight on to Sedlo.
morning.title: Coffee at Black Lake

morning.text: Left Black Lake at about 11:25 and drove P14/R-16 over Sedlo and Trsa down to Plužine, arriving about 15:00 with photo stops. Roads are paved but narrow, winding two-way mountain roads; use signed pullouts and expect to wait for passing places.
morning.title: Drive over Sedlo to Plužine

morning.text: Before committing to P14, check AMSCG road conditions, the Sedlo forecast and the host’s local report. Proceed on the primary route if open, dry enough and free of ice/low cloud. Also check AMSCG for timed daily closures for roadworks on the Plužine and P14 roads, and for snow on Sedlo. If the forecast is bad for Day 2 but good for Day 3, swap the two days.

afternoon.text: Lunch is on the Sočica terraces above the lake, so skip a separate Piva viewpoint stop today. Do not add Mratinje Dam.
afternoon.title: Piva view from the Sočica terrace

afternoon.text: Late lunch at Restoran Sočica on the terraces above Piva Lake. Tell the waiter you have about 40 minutes and order simple dishes such as local trout. Leave Plužine by 16:00 at the latest.
afternoon.title: Late lunch at Sočica

afternoon.text: Choose the return live: use M-3 via Nikšić and M-6 via Šavnik only if navigation keeps total adjusted driving ≤6 h and the Žabljak return target by 16:00. Otherwise return over Sedlo if that is the faster safe open route.

Hard decision gate in Plužine: if either return option misses the 6 h driving ceiling or leaves too little buffer before the 17:30 no-mountain-driving cutoff, shorten the stop and start back immediately; do not extend the loop.

Use marked parking only. Black Lake off-season parking is reported at €1.20/hour from Oct 1–May 31; carry coins and confirm the meter/sign. Budget Durmitor admission at the current €5/person rate if charged.

evening.text: Leave Plužine by 16:00 and return over Sedlo, arriving about 17:20; never continue mountain driving beyond 17:30.
evening.title: Drive back to Runolist over Sedlo

evening.text: Dinner at Zlatni Papagaj, which publishes 18:00–23:00 service and Montenegrin dishes; call/reserve for Oct 2, ask about payment, and walk from the chalet if practical.
evening.title: Dinner at Zlatni Papagaj

evening.text: Shop at Aroma 311 before closing for Saturday's backup packed lunch, water and snacks; do not add a morning provisioning stop.
evening.title: Stock up at Aroma 311

days.parking: Use signed Black Lake parking and marked pullouts only; do not stop on P14 blind bends. The Black Lake lot is reported at €1.20/hour off-season (Oct–May); payment type and current sign must be checked. Download the P14/R-16 map before departure.
days.cash: For two: Durmitor admission up to €10 if separately charged, Black Lake parking roughly €1.20/hour/car, optional Plužine meal at unverified price/payment. Carry small EUR notes and coins; packed lunch is the no-delay default.
days.heading: Black Lake / P14-Sedlo / Trsa / Plužine and Piva

meals.hours: Google listing shows daily service until 23:00.
meals.parking: Central Plužine street parking near the restaurant.
meals.plan: Group members rate it excellent but relatively expensive; order quickly and leave by 16:00.

meals.hours: Official site publishes 18:00–23:00; reconfirm for the date.
meals.parking: Street/town parking not verified; prefer walking from Runolist.
meals.cash: Payment method unverified; carry cash and ask.
meals.plan: Reserve or call on the day; lodging food is the late-return fallback.

supermarkets.hours: Published listing 07:30–21:30; reconfirm the day before.

days.region: North · Tara Canyon / Mojkovac / Biogradska Gora
days.drive: Runolist → Đurđevića Tara Bridge viewpoint (north side) → R-10 along the Tara via Mojkovac, with no bridge crossing → M-2 → Biogradsko Lake → R-10 back along the canyon → Tara Springs Park → Tara bridge photo stop → Runolist · about 3 h 41 nominal / 4 h 26 adjusted (OSRM +20%), within the 6 h ceiling

morning.text: Breakfast at Runolist and leave at 08:00 with water, snacks and the packed lunch as a backup. Check AMSCG and the weather, call the Tara zipline operator, and fill the tank.
morning.title: Breakfast and depart Runolist

morning.text: Drive east on the M-6 to the Žabljak (north) side of Đurđevića Tara Bridge. The bridge is closed to vehicles through Oct 26, 2026; do not cross it or enter the works, and park only in a marked public area.
morning.title: Drive to the Tara bridge viewpoint

morning.text: View the canyon and bridge from a safe public viewpoint; you arrive well before the 10:00–12:00 window when travelers report the bridge closing to pedestrians. Ride the zipline only on a line that starts and lands on this side: Red Rock needs a walk back across the bridge, so skip it. Travelers report about €50 cash per ride and a 30-minute walk and climb back. Skip the zipline if it is not running or would push departure past 09:20.
morning.title: Tara bridge viewpoint and zipline

morning.text: Turn south onto the R-10 just before the bridge; you do not cross it. The junction is close to the works, so follow any on-site diversion signs. Follow the Tara canyon to Mojkovac, then the M-2 toward Kolašin and the signed park access to Biogradsko Lake.
morning.title: Drive south via Mojkovac to Biogradsko Lake

afternoon.text: Walk the lake shore loop, about 3.5 km; allow about 90 minutes for the circuit and photos on damp autumn footing. Turn back if the trail is slippery or visibility deteriorates.
afternoon.title: Biogradsko Lake shore loop

afternoon.text: Lunch at Biogradsko Lake instead of Kolašin; the Kolašin stop was dropped on the day.
afternoon.title: Lunch at Biogradsko Lake

afternoon.text: Leave the lake around 13:45 and drive back north on the M-2 and the R-10 along the Tara canyon.
afternoon.title: Drive along the Tara canyon to Tara Springs Park

afternoon.text: Short, flat boardwalk loop between waterfalls, right beside the R-10; about 10–15 minutes of walking. Group members call it short, easy and beautiful.
afternoon.title: Tara Springs Park

afternoon.text: Continue on the R-10 to the Žabljak side of Đurđevića Tara Bridge.
afternoon.title: Drive to the Tara bridge

afternoon.text: Photo stop at the bridge in the afternoon light; do not cross it or enter the works.
afternoon.title: Tara bridge photo stop

afternoon.text: The day is about 4.4 h of adjusted driving, within the 6 h ceiling. Today's hard cutoff for driving is 18:00.

Biogradska Gora admission is currently €4/person/day; boats are €10/hour, kayaks €3 single / €5 double per hour. The park tariff does not state payment method; carry cash. Confirm October operations before budgeting boat time.

evening.text: Drive back to Runolist, about 30 minutes, arriving around 16:30.
evening.title: Drive back to Runolist

evening.text: Dinner at the Hotel Nordik restaurant (Italian and Mediterranean), about 13 minutes' drive from Runolist on the plateau road. Reserve by phone on +382 67 698 698. Group members call it the best dinner in Žabljak.
evening.title: Dinner at Hotel Nordik

evening.text: Use the short town walk only after parking at Runolist; keep the late evening restful before the Oct 4 transfer.
Stock up on water and snacks tonight: supermarkets in Montenegro are closed on Sundays by law, and Oct 4 is a Sunday.

days.parking: At Tara, use only confirmed public marked viewpoint and parking, never the road shoulder or work zone. On the return, Tara Springs Park has roadside parking by the R-10; at Biogradska Gora follow the park checkpoint and same-day vehicle-access instructions. Do not assume summer visitor trains operate in October.
days.cash: For two: Biogradska admission €8; optional boat €10/hour or double kayak €5/hour; Tara zipline about €50 cash per ride, on a same-side line only. Restaurant, parking and zipline payment methods require confirmation; carry small notes.

days.drive: Runolist → SKK Vihor (2-hour ride, 09:30) → M-6 via Šavnik → M-3 to Nikšić (packed lunch on the way) → M-7/M-8 via Grahovo → Perast (check in at Conte) → Kotor Old Town evening → Perast · about 4 h 19 nominal / 5 h 12 adjusted (OSRM +20%); the usual 17:30 mountain cutoff is waived today by the travellers, since the mountain section ends around 15:30

morning.text: Breakfast, pack the lunch, settle the Runolist checkout and leave at 09:15. Keep the €225.39 cash availability note exactly as booked; amount already paid/balance due is not stated.
morning.title: Check out and depart Runolist

morning.text: Short drive to the SKK Vihor stables in Junčev do.
morning.title: Drive to SKK Vihor

morning.text: Two-hour horse ride with SKK Vihor, confirmed for 09:30. Wear long trousers, closed shoes and a warm layer, and carry cash. Stable phone: +382 69 376 929.
morning.title: Horse ride with SKK Vihor

morning.text: Drive south on the M-6 through Šavnik and the M-3 to Nikšić; eat the packed lunch on the way.
morning.title: Drive to Nikšić via Šavnik

morning.text: No lunch time is reserved: the packed lunch is eaten on the way. If you want a quick stop in Nikšić, the options are Kastel (traditional Montenegrin, daily 07:00–23:00), Lounge Bar Piatto (4.7 on Google, 480 reviews, on the main boulevard) and La Parisienne (4.8 on Google, 263 reviews, quick and cheap). These are Google ratings, not group recommendations; check Sunday hours.
Check AMSCG road and weather notices before leaving; the route never uses the Đurđevića Tara bridge.

afternoon.text: Continue on the M-7 and M-8 through Grahovo, descend to the Bay and follow the M-1 to the signed Perast entrance parking. The Risan mosaics stop is dropped today.
afternoon.title: Drive Nikšić to Perast via Grahovo

afternoon.text: Conte booking 5198999691: Classic Double Room for 2 adults, check-in Oct 4, 15:00–21:00. Total €271.93, paid in full. Preserve the recorded itemized cancellation terms and confirmation-intro conflict. Perast old town is closed to vehicles May–October; use signed entrance parking and ask reception about pickup rather than assuming it.

Park in the signed Perast entrance lot and check in at Conte straight away (check-in from 15:00), so the bags go into the room and none stay in the car. Use only a signed official lot or the parking Conte arranges; travelers report unofficial parking attendants in Perast. Leave for Kotor around 16:05.
afternoon.title: Park in Perast and check in at Conte

afternoon.text: Take the M-1 along the Bay to Kotor and park in signed Old Town parking; Parking Benovo by the North Gate is about €2 per hour.
afternoon.title: Drive to Kotor Old Town parking

afternoon.text: Kotor Old Town in the late afternoon and evening: the lanes at sunset (about 18:35) and lit up, then dinner. Most shops are closed on Sunday, but restaurants are open. Skip the city-walls climb today.
afternoon.title: Kotor Old Town evening and dinner

evening.text: Drive back along the Bay to Perast, about 30 minutes on the coastal road.
evening.title: Drive back to Perast

evening.text: Keep the car parked overnight. Reconfirm tomorrow’s breakfast takeaway with Conte at least one day ahead and confirm the Skadar boat departure/return with its operator.

days.parking: Park in Conte’s signed Perast entrance lot (hotel-published summer parking €20/day) and check in on arrival, so no bags stay in the car. At Kotor use signed paid Old Town parking and walk; fee/space are not guaranteed.
days.cash: Conte stay €271.93 paid. Carry cash for the SKK ride, Perast parking (€20/day published), Kotor parking and dinner; payment methods are not confirmed.
days.heading: Runolist → SKK Vihor ride → Nikšić → Perast (Conte check-in) → Kotor Old Town evening

days.region: Coast / Central · Perast → Lovćen → Skadar → Perast
days.drive: Perast → Kotor espresso → Njegoš Mausoleum via R-1/R-25.1 → Kuk upper station (cable-car round trip) → Cetinje → Virpazar → Perast via Sozina · ~5 h 30 adjusted planning allowance (+20% terrain); stay ≤6 h and back by 17:00, before the 17:30 cutoff.

morning.text: Arrange Conte take-away breakfast the previous day (the hotel requires one-day notice). Leave Perast at 07:30 with water, cash and a full tank; check AMSCG road conditions and Lovćen/Kuk weather.
morning.title: Takeaway breakfast and depart Perast

morning.text: Drive directly to signed Kotor Old Town parking; allow about 20–25 minutes from Perast. Park once and walk to Small Talks.
morning.title: Drive to Kotor Old Town parking

morning.text: Stop at Small Talks at its published 08:00 opening for a quick specialty espresso; allow 20 minutes. If its live listing shows closed, use packed hotel coffee and continue.
morning.title: Espresso at Small Talks, Kotor

morning.text: At about 08:20 take the R-1 serpentine toward Njeguši, then the signed R-25.1 approach to Njegoš Mausoleum. Use live routing; the road is narrow and winding, so make the high-elevation visit in the morning.
morning.title: Drive to Njegoš Mausoleum via Njeguši

morning.text: Reach the mausoleum around its 09:00 opening. The National Museum lists daily visits through Nov 15, €8/adult, and 461 steps; allow 60 minutes and wear grippy shoes.
morning.title: Njegoš Mausoleum visit

morning.text: Continue a short distance to Kotor Cable Car’s Kuk upper station. Park there (operator lists free parking, capacity 60), ride the gondola down to Dub and back up, then use the Alpine Coaster if open. Allow 75 minutes total; skip extra Lovćen/Cetinje sightseeing.
morning.title: Kuk upper station and cable car

morning.text: The operator’s current ticket page lists Monday gondola service 09:00–20:00, last up 19:30, and coaster 10:00–19:00; weather or maintenance can suspend service. Recheck on the day. If the coaster remains closed, keep the Kuk viewpoint visit and mark the ride unavailable. Travelers report the cable car closing without notice, even on the entrance screens, and shutting when Lovćen is in cloud. If Kuk is in cloud or the gondola is stopped, skip it and continue to Cetinje.

afternoon.text: From Kuk continue via Cetinje to Virpazar without backtracking to Kotor. Reach the booked pier by 12:45 for the prebooked 13:00 one-hour departure.
afternoon.title: Drive to Virpazar via Cetinje

afternoon.text: Take the confirmed 13:00–14:00 Lake Skadar cruise. The park’s €5/person day ticket lists one cruise included; confirm the selected sailing is covered and whether the operator charges an extra fee.
afternoon.title: Lake Skadar cruise from Virpazar

afternoon.text: Have a time-boxed 45-minute lunch at Restaurant Pelikan after the cruise: local carp/eel and lake fish. Call ahead for Monday/October service, terrace seating, payment and duration; depart Virpazar by 14:45.
afternoon.title: Lunch at Restaurant Pelikan

afternoon.text: Return via the Sozina/coastal corridor; allow about 2 h 15 adjusted from Virpazar to Perast, including the +20% terrain buffer. Budget the €2.50 passenger-car Sozina toll (recheck the tariff) and set live navigation to Perast.
afternoon.title: Drive Virpazar to Perast via Sozina

afternoon.text: Target Perast by 17:00; 17:30 is the hard driving stop. The 5.5 h adjusted estimate depends on boat timing, operator service and live roads. Do not add winery or Cetinje sightseeing or a longer cruise; if any gate slips, shorten the stop and keep the 14:45 Virpazar departure.

evening.text: Final dinner in Perast at Conte or a booked local konoba; coastal fish/seafood is the corridor choice. Phone Conte if dining there; no reservation was supplied.
